name: Hanukkah Festival of Lights 3D Pop-Up Card
description_html:
🕎 Celebrate the Festival of Lights with our Elegant 3D Hanukkah Pop-up Card! 🕊️

Send your warmest wishes for peace, love, and miracles during the eight beautiful nights of Hanukkah. This meticulously handcrafted 3D pop-up card is more than just a greeting—it's a miniature piece of art perfect for displaying on a mantel or table.

✨ What makes this card special? Upon opening, a stunning golden 9-branch Menorah majestically pops up against a rich, royal blue background. It is beautifully surrounded by traditional Jewish symbols: the Star of David, peace doves carrying olive branches, dreidels, and festive treats like sufganiyot. Elegant scrolls displaying "Happy Hanukkah" and "Eight Nights of Light" complete this magnificent, classic design.

📐 Specifications:

  • Folded Size: 5 x 7 inches (Standard size, perfect for gifting and display).

  • Open Size: 10 x 7 inches with a striking 3D pop-up centerpiece.

  • Material: Premium Art Paper. Thick, durable, and eco-friendly with vibrant colors and gold foil-like accents.

  • Craftsmanship: Precision laser-cut for the finest details and 100% hand-assembled with care.

description_html:

✨ What makes this card so special? As the card opens, a magnificent two-tiered black "cake" rises, intricately designed as a haunted gothic castle.
